success.description: +4 favour, close range to the target. If you are engaged with an enemy, add 1 {Dm} to your dice pool. When this card is recharging and you are within close range of the target, you suffer wounds in the target’s stead. Use the target’s Toughness, soak, and other values to reduce damage and then suffer the wounds (including any criticals) yourself.

boon.description: You and the target each recover 1 fatigue

bane.description: You and the target each suffer 1 stress

chaosStar.description: Use your Toughness, soak, and other values instead of the target’s!
